title: I went to the Renaissance fair and got a lesson in belonging

text: Evening EditionI went to the Renaissance fair and got a lesson in belongingMaybe the least serious places are some of the most important.Halina BennetOct 10, 2026∙ PaidCrowds gather over ale during Halina’s recent trip to the Maryland Renaissance Festival. (Photo by the author)By 10, the field was full of people in preparation. A woman braced one hand against the side of her Honda and tugged with the other at the laces of her bodice, one rib at a time, until woman and garment both sighed into place.
